paragraphs.source_en: As the dagger closed upon his throat, Tadayoshi desperately tried to fend it off, but his wounded arm would not obey him. He braced himself against his enemy's arm, trying to force the blade away. Yet the more he struggled, the deeper his body sank into the mud, until even the slightest movement became difficult. Dread filled him: Am I to die in battle in a place like this?

units.source_zh: “还是让他跑了。”

units.source_en: Yet Naomasa felt neither regret nor disappointment. Instead, a refreshing satisfaction rose within him.
units.source_zh: 但这不是后悔或遗憾，直政反觉心中爽快。

units.source_en: The pursuers had enjoyed a magnificent chase, and the retreating men had struck back with equal brilliance.
units.source_zh: 追击者追得痛快，撤退者反击得也很是漂亮。

paragraphs.source_zh: “还是让他跑了。”但这不是后悔或遗憾，直政反觉心中爽快。追击者追得痛快，撤退者反击得也很是漂亮。

paragraphs.source_en: When Ii Naomasa regained consciousness, he ordered solemnly, “My wounds are not grave. Nevertheless, pursue them no farther.” Because his wounds required treatment and they were also concerned about Tadayoshi's injuries, the men withdrew.

units.source_en: When Ii Naomasa regained consciousness, he ordered solemnly, “My wounds are not grave.
units.source_zh: 井伊直政省过神来，神情严肃地吩咐道：“受伤不重。

units.source_en: Nevertheless, pursue them no farther.”
units.source_zh: 但是，休要再追了。”

units.source_en: Because his wounds required treatment and they were also concerned about Tadayoshi's injuries, the men withdrew.
units.source_zh: 由于要治伤，又担心忠吉的伤势，众人撤了回去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 井伊直政省过神来，神情严肃地吩咐道：“受伤不重。但是，休要再追了。”由于要治伤，又担心忠吉的伤势，众人撤了回去。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus the veteran general Shimazu Yoshihiro succeeded in making his escape.

units.source_en: Thus the veteran general Shimazu Yoshihiro succeeded in making his escape.
units.source_zh: 就这样，老将岛津义弘方成功逃脱。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就这样，老将岛津义弘方成功逃脱。

paragraphs.source_en: When Chōsokabe Morichika, encamped at Kurihara Village below Mount Nangū, learned what had happened to the Shimazu, he ordered his troops to retreat toward Ise. This unexpectedly became the signal that the Battle of Sekigahara was over.

units.source_en: When Chōsokabe Morichika, encamped at Kurihara Village below Mount Nangū, learned what had happened to the Shimazu, he ordered his troops to retreat toward Ise. This unexpectedly became the signal that the Battle of Sekigahara was over.
units.source_zh: 驻扎在南宫山下栗原村的长曾我部盛亲得知岛津战况，遂命令部队向伊势撤退，这竟成了关原合战结束的信号。

paragraphs.source_zh: 驻扎在南宫山下栗原村的长曾我部盛亲得知岛津战况，遂命令部队向伊势撤退，这竟成了关原合战结束的信号。

paragraphs.source_en: Held in check by the Ikeda and Asano forces, Morichika had never dared make a rash move; moreover, even at the very end, the intentions of the Mōri contingent still seemed impossible to determine. His retainer Yoshida Magoemon, whom he had stationed at Sekigahara beforehand, returned with word that the Shimazu force had been routed and not a single Western Army soldier remained anywhere around Sekigahara.

units.source_en: Held in check by the Ikeda and Asano forces, Morichika had never dared make a rash move; moreover, even at the very end, the intentions of the Mōri contingent still seemed impossible to determine.
units.source_zh: 在池田和浅野二部的压制下，盛亲一直不敢轻举妄动，而且，一直到最后，毛利部的去向似乎仍难以确定。

units.source_en: His retainer Yoshida Magoemon, whom he had stationed at Sekigahara beforehand, returned with word that the Shimazu force had been routed and not a single Western Army soldier remained anywhere around Sekigahara.
units.source_zh: 事先安插到关原的家臣吉田孙右卫门又回来报说，由于岛津部大溃，关原一带已不见一个西军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在池田和浅野二部的压制下，盛亲一直不敢轻举妄动，而且，一直到最后，毛利部的去向似乎仍难以确定。事先安插到关原的家臣吉田孙右卫门又回来报说，由于岛津部大溃，关原一带已不见一个西军。

paragraphs.source_en: At almost the same moment, news of the crushing defeat reached Nagatsuka Masaie's camp as well. But when Masaie's messenger reached Mitsunari's camp on foot, the main body of Ishida's army had long since vanished without a trace.

units.source_en: At almost the same moment, news of the crushing defeat reached Nagatsuka Masaie's camp as well.
units.source_zh: 几乎就在同时，长束正家阵营也传来了惨败的消息。

units.source_en: But when Masaie's messenger reached Mitsunari's camp on foot, the main body of Ishida's army had long since vanished without a trace.
units.source_zh: 而当正家派人徒步赶到三成阵营，石田的主力早就踪影全无。

paragraphs.source_zh: 几乎就在同时，长束正家阵营也传来了惨败的消息。而当正家派人徒步赶到三成阵营，石田的主力早就踪影全无。

paragraphs.source_en: Night was about to fall, and the chill battlefield enfolded boundless bloodshed, joy, and grief within its cold indifference. At twilight, Tokugawa Ieyasu's rain-soaked golden-fan standard solemnly crossed the Fuji River and advanced toward the heights to the west...

units.source_en: Night was about to fall, and the chill battlefield enfolded boundless bloodshed, joy, and grief within its cold indifference.
units.source_zh: 夜幕即将降临，清冷的战场把无尽的热血和悲喜包藏在了冷漠之中。

units.source_en: At twilight, Tokugawa Ieyasu's rain-soaked golden-fan standard solemnly crossed the Fuji River and advanced toward the heights to the west...
units.source_zh: 薄暮之时，德川家康那濡湿的金扇马印肃然渡过藤川，向西面高地挺进……

paragraphs.source_zh: 夜幕即将降临，清冷的战场把无尽的热血和悲喜包藏在了冷漠之中。薄暮之时，德川家康那濡湿的金扇马印肃然渡过藤川，向西面高地挺进……
